description.en: Extracting valuable insights from massive user feedback, transforming user voice into improvement directions
description.zh: 从海量用户反馈中提炼有价值洞察，将用户声音转化为改进方向

welcome_message.en: We have collected a lot of user feedback but struggle to extract valuable insights. Please, Feedback Synthesis Analyst, help us discover product improvement opportunities from the feedback.
